0022600100.text: Utah, 0-1 and 12th in the West, hosts the 0-1 Pelicans, who are 8th in the West, in the Jazz's second game of the 2026-27 season. The Jazz are without Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), both listed as out. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost the series 0-3, most recently 156-137 in New Orleans on April 7, 2026.
